Playing with Fire · Stories around the fire

Long before anyone wrote, people sat around a fire and told stories.

Dark room, one fire. Pull your chairs closer. Open with the fire, not with yourself. Long before writing: fire, people, stories.

Fire was one of our first technologies.

Tonight we talk about what might be the latest one.

One of the first technologies: light, warmth, cooking, gathering. Latest one: AI. Same mix of wonder and burnt fingers. Tonight it's just a spark.

Who's telling the stories tonight

Short, not a CV. Hippie parents → farm kid → winery → wine engineer → public administration → vibecoder. No computer science anywhere in it. Keep that in mind.

And yet

41 repositories

One tile per repository.

41 repositories, one tile each. Everyday tools, family and winery, play, talks, VAVE.
I'm not a developer. My day job is in public administration, not in IT. What I am is a translator: I know what the problem feels like, and I've learnt to explain it to a machine.
Say it plainly, no apology. Translator: problem → machine. That's a skill designers already have.

The trail of the evening

Eight camps, one evening

A spark, kindling, a camp of many fires, smoke, embers.

The evening is the life of a fire. Spark → kindling → many fires → smoke → embers. Eight camps on the board, we walk them in order.

Sticks for the fire

Questions keep it burning

Throw one in any time, as a bubble on the board.

Questions = sticks for the fire. Any time. Bubble on the board, QR code, no account needed. I pick them up as we go.
Ember: if he can, you can. Then the board: "One word: right now, AI makes me feel …". Read three out loud. Then the old tales.
